scenarios.prompt: Explain why an AI startup can gain users while becoming financially weaker.

decision.message: AI startups often gain users by focusing on solving a specific problem they're good at, like making AI tools super easy to use. But as they grow, they spend more on scaling (like hiring, servers, and marketing) than they make from users, so their cash gets tighter even though they're getting more users.
